breathing.name: Paced breathing
breathing.description: Four counts in. Six counts out. Follow a gentle circle or just the words.

grounding.name: 5–4–3–2–1 grounding
grounding.description: Move through five senses, one small observation at a time. No writing needed.

steps.title: 5 things you can see
steps.instruction: Notice five things you can see around you.
steps.note: No need to type or name them aloud. If a sense is unavailable, you can recall a familiar example, or pause or end.

steps.title: 4 things you can feel
steps.instruction: Notice four things you can feel, such as contact with your chair, clothing or the floor.
steps.note: Follow in your own way. Pause if you would like more time.

steps.title: 3 things you can hear
steps.instruction: Notice three things you can hear around you.
steps.note: If this sense is unavailable, you can recall a familiar sound, or pause or end.

steps.title: 2 things you can smell
steps.instruction: Notice two things you can smell.
steps.note: A familiar scent can be recalled. There is nothing to enter or prove.

steps.title: 1 thing you can taste
steps.instruction: Notice one thing you can taste.
steps.note: You can recall a familiar taste. The sequence will finish; starting again is optional.

stop.name: The STOP practice
stop.description: Stop. Take a step back. Observe. Proceed mindfully. Four clear prompts.

steps.title: Stop
steps.instruction: Pause what you are doing for a moment.
steps.note: Nothing to type. You can pause or end this practice whenever you choose.

steps.title: Take a step back
steps.instruction: Take a step back from the situation for a moment.
steps.note: This can be a mental pause; no physical movement is required.

steps.title: Observe
steps.instruction: Notice what is happening inside you and around you: thoughts, feelings and your surroundings.
steps.note: You do not need to judge, explain or share what you notice.

steps.title: Proceed mindfully
steps.instruction: Consider how you want to proceed, then choose your next action mindfully.
steps.note: The app does not choose an action for you. Take your time; continuing is your choice.
